text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Evening. Walking through the shopping district after a street performance—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer, look, look!
They're doing something over there!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the fun, fun lottery!
Anyone and everyone, come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
Falco's got it all figured out!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: You're being tested right now.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Falco's—
Star power as an umadol!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
When we bought snacks earlier,
we got a raffle ticket, right?
Just a single raffle ticket...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Does this mean, in other words—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Can you win the grand prize
with just one single chance?"
...I'm totally being tested here...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: It's the God of Star Power!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Anyway! As an Umadol, when put to the test, you've gotta overcome it!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Falco will prove that she's
got what it takes to be at the top!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Smart Falcon eagerly grabbed the raffle machine's lever—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Falco's aura, shine bright☆
Hup♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I spun the wheel!
And the result is—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: It's heeeeeere☆☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Did you see that!?
Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
This is the power of the strongest☆Umadol!
Falco's true strength!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thanks☆
I'm not an Umadol just for show!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, totally satisfied♪
Alright, shall we head home—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Hey, little Umamusume missy!
You forgot the most important prize!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Heh.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: A "Hot Springs Trip Ticket", huh~.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'd love to, but...
when should I go?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I just set my goal to
"take 1st place in everything," after all.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Maybe after everything's over, huh?
choice_data_list: You can save it as a reward.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yeah, you're right—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Wait, why are you acting like this is someone else's problem?
Trainer, you're coming with me, you know!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: "Because, if it's a reward for Falco, you should get one too, Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: "Aren't we comrades sharing the same dream? In it together till the end, right? ☆"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Besides, if it's after everything is over,
Falco will definitely be a top Umadol by then!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: A top umadol needs bodyguards for her private life, doesn't she?
choice_data_list: Is that how you really feel?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ......Ehehe, ya caught me☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Dense Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"It's nothing~☆
I can't wait for our reward hot springs trip!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I ended up holding onto
the "Hot Springs Trip Ticket" for now.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yay! First prize☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
We didn't get the grand prize, but...!
Even so~!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
First prize basically means first place!
And 'Premium Salisbury Steak' is extra special!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"In other words... Falco's
umadol power is super special!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Right? That's fine, isn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: All riiight♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Tonight's dinner is super special!
I'm inviting you to the Falco Dinner Show☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so that night, we spent a luxurious time together listening to a cheerful Smart Falcon sing.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Grin!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: —A big bright smile brings good fortune~♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Wow, sooo many carrots☆
How should I eat them~♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I know!
If we have this many—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hellooo, everyone ☆
It's Falco~!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Today's street live is a special edition!
Believe it or not, everyone who watched gets...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
One carrot☆
Hand-delivered by Falco herself♪

text_block_list.name: Persevering Umamusume S
text_block_list.text: Carrots...

text_block_list.name: Gray-haired Umamusume O
text_block_list.text: Carrots...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for sticking with me until the very end today too!
Let's get hyped up~☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It felt like... there were more Umamusume in the crowd than usual during that day's street live.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You know, there's something Falco holds very dear
as an umadol.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see. If the fans wish for it,
I'll sing and dance anytime, anywhere!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
So, you see, that single carrot...
No, that carrot mic.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Since Falco got her hands on the carrot mic,
that must mean—"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I think it means people finally recognize
what a wonderful Umadol Falco is...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, God of Star Power.
Falco's gonna do her best...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Sparkle*...☆)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As if responding to Smart Falcon's words,
a star twinkled amidst the sunset glow... or so it seemed.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I didn't lose!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
A miss doesn't mean defeat!!
So Falco still has a chance!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It does... right?
It has to...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...Falco, is your aura really
only as thick as a single tissue?"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: —Just kidding~☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry! Even tissues get thick 
if you stack enough of them together!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
So……
Aha, ahahaha……

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though she put on a brave front,
Smart Falcon's smile was a little stiff.
